questions.question: Bangladesh does not share its boundary with which of the following Indian states?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim.**__

Bangladesh shares its borders with the Indian states of **West Bengal, Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Bangladesh is a country in South Asia that shares its border with India to the north, east, and west, Myanmar to the east, and the Bay of Bengal to the south.
 
• Tripura, Assam, West Bengal, Meghalaya, and Mizoram are the Indian state that shares their border with Bangladesh. 
 
• **Dhaka, Rangpur, Khulna, Sylhet, Rajshahi, and Chittagong are the division of Bangladesh that are situated along the India Bangladesh Border.**
 
• Nagaland does not share a border with Bangladesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Bangladesh is commemorating its 50th independence day on March 26, 2021.
 
• **Bangladesh was proclaimed as an independent nation by Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and this led to Bangladesh Liberation War when a guerilla war ensued between Pakistan and Bangladesh liberation forces with Indian support.**
 
• It launched a 10-day “golden jubilee” on March 17 with parades, fireworks, and tributes to independence hero Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.

​ [IMAGE: https://www.drishtiias.com/images/uploads/1570434960_image5.jpg]

questions.question: Which of the following is the highest mountain in Bhutan?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gangkhar Puensum**.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Gangkhar Puensum is the highest point in Bhutan and the highest unclimbed mountain in the world.
 
• Other important peaks:
 
 
• Mount Everest is the world's highest mountain.
 
• The Sandakphu is the highest peak in West Bengal.
 
• The Doddabetta is the highest peak of Tamilnadu.
 
• Deomali is the highest mountain peak in Odhisha.
 
• The highest Mountain in Victoria is Mount Bogong.
 
• Kalsubai Shikhar is the highest mountain peak in Maharashtra.
 
• Nanda Devi is the highest mountain in Uttarakhand.
 
• Kangchenjunga is the highest peak in India & the third highest summit in the World.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kula Kangri:**

 
 
• It is one of the loftiest mountain peaks of the Himalayas Mountain like Chomolhari and Manaslu.
 
 
 
• **Gipmochi :**
 
 
• This mountain lies between China, Bhutan, and the Indian state of Sikkim.
 
• Gipmochi mountain is also known as **Gyemo Chen**.
 
• Gyemo Chen is called The Great Queen in the local language.
 
• It is a part of the Greater Himalayas.
 
• The mountain is located at the** tri-junction of China, Bhutan, and India.**

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT an east-flowing river of Karnataka?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mandavi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **East Flowing River of Karnataka**__
 
• __**Tungabhadra River**__
 __
 
• It is a sacred river in southern India that **flows through the state of Karnataka to Andhra Pradesh.** 
 
• The ancient name of the river was **Pampa**.
 
• The river is approximately 710 km long, and it drains an area of 72,200 sq km.
 
• It is** formed by the confluence of two rivers, the Tunga River and the Bhadra River.** 
 
• Both Tunga & Bhadra Rivers originate on the eastern slopes of the **Western Ghats**.
 
• The greater part of the Tungabhadra’s course **lies in the southern part of the Deccan plateau.** 
 
• The river is fed mainly by rain, and it has a monsoonal regimen with summer high water.
 
• Its **major tributaries** are the** Bhadra**, the **Haridra**, the **Vedavati**, the **Tunga**, the **Varda,** and the **Kumdavathi**.
 
• **It flows in a more or less northwest direction before joining the eastern river, Krishna. The Krishna River finally ends in the Bay of Bengal. Hence, It is the east-flowing river.**
 
 
 
• **Bhima river**__
 __
 
• It is also known as the **Chandra Bhaga** river.
 
• Bhima is the **longest** (largest is Tungabhadra) tributary of the river **Krishna**.
 
• It originates in the **Bhimashankar hills** in the Pune district of Maharashtra.
 
• Bhima river flows for a length of 861 km through the states of **Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Telangana**, and then merges into river Krishna at Raichur in Karnataka. Hence, It is the east-flowing river.
 
• Bhima river has many tributaries such as **Ghod, Sina, Awarja, Kagna, Nira, Mon,** etc.
 
 
 
• **Manjira river**__
 __
 
• Length(KM): 724
 
• Catchment Area(sq km): 30844
 
• Originates in the **Balaghat Range** -Bhir district of Maharashtra
 
• **It flows in an east and south-easterly direction for about 512 km through the Osmanabad district -of Maharashtra, Bidar district of Mysore and Medak district of Andhra Pradesh before changing its direction Northwards near Sanga Reddipet. **Hence, It is the east-flowing river.
 
• After flowing for about 75 km further, the Manjira river enters the Nizamabad district of Andhra Pradesh and it also **forms the boundary between Maharashtra and Andhra Pradesh.**
 
 
 
• **Mahadayi or Mhadei**__
 
 
• It is the **west-flowing river, that originates in Bhimgad Wildlife Sanctuary (Western Ghats)**, Belagavi district of **Karnataka**. Hence, It is a west-flowing river. Hence, Option 3 is correct.
 
• It is essentially a **rain-fed river** also called **Mandovi **in Goa.
 
• It is joined by a number of streams to form the Mandovi which is one of two major rivers (the other one is the Zuari river) that flows through Goa.
 
• The river travels 35 km in Karnataka; 82 km in Goa before joining the Arabian Sea.

questions.question: Which of the following oceans is surrounded by the continent of North America and South America to the east?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Atlantic Ocean**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atlantic Ocean** is the ocean that is surrounded by the continent of North America and South America to the east.
 
• The Atlantic Ocean is the second-largest of the world's oceans, covering approximately 20% of Earth's surface.
 
• It separates the "Old World" from the "New World" and has been a critical route for exploration, trade, and travel.
 
• It connects to the Arctic Ocean in the north and the Southern Ocean in the south.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Pacific Ocean** is located to the west of North and South America and is the largest ocean on Earth.
 
• The **Indian Ocean** lies to the east of Africa and south of Asia, bordered by the Arabian Peninsula and Australia.
 
• The **Arctic Ocean** is the smallest and shallowest of the world's five major oceans and is located around the Arctic Circle.
 
• Oceans play a crucial role in regulating the Earth's climate and are home to diverse marine ecosystems.

questions.question: What is the name of the geographic feature that serves as a boundary between Europe and Africa?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Strait of Gibraltar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Strait of Gibraltar **lies between the **southern tip of Spain (Europe) and the northern tip of Morocco (Africa)**.
 
• It **connects the Atlantic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea** and** separates Southern Spain in Europe from Northern Morocco in Africa**.
 
• It is strategically important as it serves as the gateway between the Mediterranean Sea and the Atlantic Ocean.
 
• This strait has been a significant maritime route for centuries, facilitating **trade** and cultural exchange between Europe and Africa.
 
• It is** one of the busiest maritime routes** in the world, with both commercial ships and naval vessels passing through it regularly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/149749c2bf2426fe542db7371aafa4fb9c5eb59e39271ec4c0793a2c7e563c4a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Bosporus Strait** connects the Black Sea to the Sea of Marmara and separates Europe from Asia in Turkey.
 
• The **Dardanelles Strait** also in Turkey, connects the Aegean Sea to the Sea of Marmara.
 
• The **Malacca Strait** is located between the Malay Peninsula and the Indonesian island of Sumatra, connecting the Pacific Ocean to the Indian Ocean.

questions.question: Which is the second highest mountain in the Garhwal region of Uttarakhand?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kamet**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Kamet (7,756 metres):

 
 
• ​Kamet, mountain peak of the Himalayas in Uttarakhand state, northern India, 
 
• It is near the border with the Tibet Autonomous Region of China.
 
• It is part of the Zaskar range.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Nanda Devi :

 
 
• It is a part of Himalayan mountain ranges (Garhwal).
 
• This is the highest peak **(7816 metres)** located entirely within India.
 
• The Nanda Devi National Prak, located in vicinity to the peak, consists of the best high altitude flora and fauna.
 
 
 
• **Nilkantha:-**
 
 
• It is a majestic peak with an elevation of 6,596 meters (21,640 feet) above sea level.
 
• It is a prominent and sacred mountain in the region, and its name is derived from Lord Shiva, who is often referred to as "Nilkantha" (meaning "blue throat") in Hindu mythology.
 
 
 
• **Meru:-**
 
 
• Also known as Meru Peak, is another prominent mountain in the Garhwal region of Uttarakhand, India.
 
• It is often confused with Nilkantha due to their similar locations and proximity. Meru Peak is distinct from Nilkantha, and it holds great significance for mountaineers.

questions.question: Sri Lanka is separated from India by the _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Palk Strait**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Palk Strait**

 
 
• The strait is between southeastern India and northern Sri Lanka.
 
• The southwestern portion of the strait is also called **Palk Bay.**
 
• The strait is named after **Robert Palk, who was a governor of Madras during the Company Raj period.**
 
• The strait is** 40 to 85 miles (64 to 137 km) wide, 85 miles long, and less than 330 feet (100 meters) deep.**
 
• It receives several rivers, including the** Vaigai (India), and it contains many islands on the Sri Lankan side.**
 
• The port of Jaffna, the commercial** centre for northern Sri Lanka, lies on the strait.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Major straits of the world-

 
 
• The Strait of Gibraltar connects the Atlantic Ocean and the Mediterranean sea.
 
• The Strait of Hormuz connects the Gulf of Oman and the Persian Gulf, it is situated between Iran and Oman
 
• The Strait of Bering connects the Arctic Ocean and the eastern Pacific Ocean.
 
• The Strait of Florida connects the Gulf of Mexico and the Atlantic ocean.
 
• Yucanton strait connects the Gulf of Mexico and the Caribbean Sea.
 
• The Strait of Sunda connects the Java Sea and the Indian Ocean. It is located between Java Island and Sumatra Island.
 
• Bab-al-Mandeb connects the Gulf of Aden And The Red Sea.
 
• The 10-degree channel separates the Andaman sea and the Bay of Bengal.
 
• Duncan passage little Andaman is separated from great Andaman by the Duncan passage.
 
• The 9-degree channel separates Kavaratti from Minicoy Island.
 
• The 8-degree channel separates Minicoy Island from the Maldives.
 
• Strait of Malacca joins the Andaman sea and the South China Sea.
 
• Palk strait connects the Bay of Bengal and Pak Bay or the Arabian Sea in the southwest.

questions.question: Identify the city which is situated on the banks of river Sarayu.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Ayodhya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• River Sarayu :

 
 
• Ayodhya, a city in Uttar Pradesh is situated on the banks of the River Sarayu.​
 
• The Sarayu originates from Lake Mansarovar in the Himalayas.
 
• It is also known as the Ghaghra and the Manas Nandini.
 
• It merges with the Ganga in Bihar.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• River Narmada:

 
 
• It is the largest west-flowing river.
 
• It acts as the boundary between North and South India. 
 
• It originates in the **Amarkantak plateau**, where the **Vindhya and Satpura mountain ranges meet.**
 
• It flows through the states of **Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Gujarat before emptying into the Arabian sea.**
 
 
 
• River Periyar:
 
 
• It is the longest river in the state of **Kerala**.
 
• It is also known as The lifeline of Kerala.
 
• It originates in the **Sivagiri Hills of the Western Ghats.**
 
• **It empties or drains into the Arabian Sea.**
 
 
 
• River Mandovi:
 
 
• It originates in the Western Ghats of Belagavi district, **Karnataka.**
 
• Panaji is situated on the banks of the river “**Mandovi**”.
 
• It is described as the lifeline of the Indian state of Goa. 
 
• The river passes through **Karnataka **and goa before it emptying into the Arabian Sea.
